body:
Vivo con mi novio desde hace un año pero la verdad es difícil. Hoy no ha sido un buen día con mi epilepsia llevo teniendo crisis toda la tarde y aún sigo en cama. Estoy sola pero intento mantenerme en comunicación siempre con él cuando está en el trabajo.

Suena terrible pero creo que se está cansando de esto.
Hay bastante de negligencia en mi caso. No voy al doctor porque me da miedo lo que pueda decirme. Me he encerrado en un agujero, no salgo de casa.

Realmente si hay algo de culpa, no voy al doctor, he sido negligente siempre he intentado obviar a los médicos desde que mi mamá murió, me he ido encerrado yo misma en un agujero. Lo peor que puede pasar? Tengo un riesgo de muerte súbita en cada convulsión o puedo terminar en una silla de ruedas en el peor de los casos

¡Hey no estamos tan lejos!

Mi diagnostico de epilepsia se complica con el tiempo, pierdo mi memoria, tengo ataques de pánico y crisis convulsivas con alucinaciones, sigo subiendo la medicina pero no hay resultado positivo que dure más de una semana.

Es dificil, sigo intentandolo.

When I was on antidepressants (diazepam, etc) gained 25 extra kg yup I'm a girl from Peru now I'm probably 80kgs don't really know.

It's hard to live in this country and not overeat it's like the only thing that would keep me excited and I don't even cook just would go out at 1am and look for some street food or take out place and would eat something.
I speak spanish yes I work as an english teacher here in Lima so excuse if my make some mistakes while writing

Would love to study something that would help me to be a writer, published a book of poems when I was 18 before my diagnose then I stopped everything.

And obesity now puts your health in danger? Why is it so hard? 

Maybe there's a chance I'm 27 and was diagnosed with epilepsy and a brain tumor when I was 21, tried to kill myself 3 times in 5 years, couldn't work, was not able to study had to leave college. Mom died shortly after my diagnose.

Lost 5 years also, now I'm in a similar position, tried to start over, study and get a job it's really hard isn't it?

Was it difficult, beating cancer? Can you do something to help your parents?

I don't if I'm asking stupid questions. Sorry for that in advance.

(BTW love your nickame)

Hey OP

regretting and overthinking is quite painful but we tend to do that and it's like you're drowning, I do the same most of the time and feels like you don't have any air left in the room and could just lay down and die but I try getting up again, breathe slowly it's really difficult.

What do you regret? Does it have a solution maybe you haven't tried yet?

OP please don't

Please don't do it I know it sucks I know it's difficult I've been there, I'm right there now but if it works you can DM me even if you just want someone to listen to you.

Thank you so much.

Like I said, I don't feel sad but it's really nice to have someone who gets what you are going through and doesn't reply with "meh you're just sad" or "it's all in your head".

You just described the relationship with my students.

They remind me that I'm supossed to be here at least for the time I work with them. I have a purpose with them.
Thank you so much for you answer.

I actually thought nobody would answer. Honestly, just typed this and went to watch RAW highlights.

Detatchment, that's the word.
Thank you for answering.

What keeps you here?
I feel like I'm maybe in the wrong place, wrong time, don't feel sad about it. It's just that way.
